cooldown.binNote: Bin gives a flat 4s cooldown at every rank (YasuoQ1Wrapper.Cooldown=4). The wiki's cooldown template is not a per-rank leveling array but a formula reducing the base 4s cooldown by bonus attack speed (down to 1.48s at 111.1% bonus AS); the base value (4) matches the bin.

castTime.binNote: No cast time field appears in the sheet's Q rows; the 0.35s base thrust cast time (reduced by bonus attack speed, capped at 50% reduction) is wiki-only.

values.binNote: TotalDamageCrit multiplies the AD-ratio portion (105% AD) by the champion's current critDamage multiplier; this schema's single stat+coef term cannot express that multiplicative combination, see mechanics.

values.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Gathering Storm'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits

mechanics.claim: Steel Tempest applies basic damage (on-hit/on-attack effects) only to the first (closest) enemy hit; secondary enemies take area damage and only they receive spell effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Steel Tempest'' applies {{tip|basic damage}} to the first (closest) enemy hit and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary enemies

mechanics.claim: Life steal heals based on damage dealt to the first target hit; spell vamp only heals from damage to secondary targets at 33% effectiveness.
mechanics.quote: {{as|{{sti|Life steal}}}} will heal based on the damage dealt to the first target hit.

mechanics.claim: Steel Tempest rolls its critical strikes individually against each enemy hit.
mechanics.quote: ''Steel Tempest'' rolls its {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} individually against each enemy hit.

mechanics.claim: At 2 Gathering Storm stacks, the next Steel Tempest cast consumes them to become an empowered whirlwind dealing the same damage (with knockup) to enemies in the direction, rather than a thrust.
mechanics.quote: At 2 stacks, the next ''Steel Tempest'' cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.

mechanics.claim: Critical Strike Damage multiplies the AD-ratio portion of the base damage by Yasuo's crit damage multiplier, rather than critting the whole ability value.
Casting Steel Tempest during Sweeping Blade removes its cast time but locks out basic attacks for 0.5 seconds after the dash ends.
mechanics.quote: ''Steel Tempest's'' cast time is not incurred when it is cast this way, but '''Yasuo''' will become {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the dash ends.

mechanics.claim: If Yasuo is affected by disarming crowd control during the cast time, the thrust fails to hit but the cooldown is reset to 0.1 seconds.
mechanics.quote: the {{sti|cooldown}} of the ability is reset to {{fd|0.1}} seconds
